summary: Purple Biotech filed a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) disclosing an abrupt CEO transition effective October 5, 2026. CEO Gil Efron ceased serving as CEO, moving to Executive Director, Head of Corporate Development, while remaining a board member; director and former CEO Isaac Israel was appointed Interim CEO pending a permanent replacement. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. The board made the appointments. Watch for permanent CEO timing, strategic direction, and any subsequent operational or financing signals from the interim leadership.
